title: SidMesh node manifest
description: node.json at the root of a node directory. A node is a unit of responsibility; it owns one or more capabilities declared by the contracts in its contracts/ directory.

id.description: Unique node id. Every capability this node owns is named <id>.<verb>.

responsibility.description: One sentence: what this node is responsible for.

notOwned.description: What this node explicitly does not do, so neighbours and agents do not push it there.

runtime.description: Language the handlers are written in. Decides which worker (task queue) runs them.

permissions.description: Permissions a principal needs to call any capability of this node.
